title: Sokal's conjecture on functional-digraph component polynomials
statement:
Let $\psi_{n,k}$ be the number of functional digraphs on $[n]$ with $k$ weakly connected components, and define

$$
\bm{\psi}_n(y)=\sum_{k=0}^n\psi_{n,k}y^k.
$$

A functional digraph is a directed graph in which every vertex has out-degree $1$; a vertex is cyclic if it lies on a directed cycle. Let $[\psi_{n,k}]_{n,k}$ denote the lower-triangular counting matrix.

**Sokal's functional-digraph conjecture.** The following assertions hold:
(i) $[\psi_{n,k}]_{n,k}$ is totally positive;
(ii) $(\bm{\psi}_n(y))_{n\geq0}$ is coefficientwise Hankel-totally positive in $y$;
(iii) $(\psi_{n+1,1})_{n\geq0}$ is Hankel-totally positive, equivalently, it is a Stieltjes moment sequence.

These assertions concern positivity of functional-digraph enumeration matrices, component polynomials, and the connected case. The source gives no resolution, so the conjecture remains open.
source_name: Bao-Xuan Zhu, “Coefficientwise Hankel-total positivity of the row-generating polynomials for the output matrices of certain production matrices”, arXiv:2202.03793 (2024).
references:
**3 papers in this index state this conjecture** (2016–2022). The statement above is taken from the most recent of them; the others are [arXiv:2006.14485](https://arxiv.org/abs/2006.14485), [arXiv:1612.04114](https://arxiv.org/abs/1612.04114).

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2202.03793

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of February 2022).
